findings.text: The text assumes the comparison and evaluation groups still need to be formed "using their existing semantic boundaries". The current code already splits comparison, evaluation and resolution into separate tests (`tests/conformance_query_mutants_test.py:38-58`). The seven-mutant evaluation group is already one such boundary, and it is the one that hit the limit at 303.16 seconds. Fix: say that the groups exist and that the evaluation group must be split further, or its measured cost reduced, while each exact edit, target and guard stays as it is.
